prompt_en:
Build a decision log distinguishing proposals from actual approvals.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-000, status approved, budget 8461 euros, deadline 2026-11-02. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-001, status suspended, budget 5048 euros, deadline 2026-11-03. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Diego, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-002, status under review, budget 4464 euros, deadline 2026-11-04. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-003, status approved, budget 8871 euros, deadline 2026-11-05. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Fabio, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-004, status approved, budget 5243 euros, deadline 2026-11-06. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-005, status suspended, budget 4334 euros, deadline 2026-11-07. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-006, status under review, budget 3693 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Luca, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-007, status approved, budget 3977 euros, deadline 2026-11-09. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Marta, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-008, status approved, budget 418 euros, deadline 2026-11-10. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Nadia, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-009, status suspended, budget 1404 euros, deadline 2026-11-11. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
